title: Sales Funnel Stencil
conversionGoal: Move qualified visitors from offer interest to pricing, checkout, and confirmed purchase.
notes: Normalized from multi-section SaaS marketing templates with separate offer and checkout surfaces.
Proof, features, pricing, FAQ, and guarantee are preserved as structure only.
Branded media, premium-theme styling, and dynamic carousel behavior were removed.

sources.notes: Confirmed hero, workflows, features, testimonials, and CTA sequencing for offer-led pages.
Added explicit pricing-table and FAQ page structure.
Expanded normalized pricing-plan, comparison, and sale CTA archetypes.

placeholderTokens.description: Offer price for a plan or package.

sections.name: Hero
sections.purpose: State the sales offer and push the visitor into the offer flow.

sections.name: ProofStrip
sections.purpose: Provide immediate authority and trust markers.

sections.name: BenefitsSection
sections.purpose: Translate the offer into business outcomes.

sections.name: FeatureGrid
sections.purpose: Break the offer into concrete components or capabilities.

sections.name: TestimonialGrid
sections.purpose: Support the offer with customer proof.

sections.name: PricingTable
sections.purpose: Show the package or tier options available to buy.

sections.name: CheckoutPanel
sections.purpose: Capture buyer details and confirm order summary.

sections.name: ConfirmationPanel
sections.purpose: Confirm the order and set delivery expectations.

sections.name: NextStepPanel
sections.purpose: Route the buyer into onboarding or the next conversion step.

sections.name: CTASection
